Context from 89b394 (PR #146): out/ restore no longer checks listing-time lengths. A removed Colab runtime can still, inside its ~30 s SIGTERM grace, (a) create a new out/ file and update out.json before restore, with no presigned GET for the new key, or (b) upload after restore and overwrite newer bytes. Fence with attempt-scoped or revocable grants, or wait out teardown. See scratch/questions.md in the 89b394 checkout.
